visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Seven musicians are positioned in a domestic music studio. In the center foreground, a young woman (labeled '4') sits cross-legged on the floor, wearing a light blue long-sleeved crop top and navy leggings, actively playing a silver transverse flute with moving fingers and rhythmic head sways. On the right, two women ('1' and '2') in casual blouses hold cellos in playing positions but remain perfectly still. Behind the flute player, a man ('3') in a black t-shirt holds an acoustic guitar statically. To the left, a woman ('5') in a white blouse holds a violin and bow to her shoulder, frozen in place. In the background left, two men ('6' and '7') are positioned at a double bass and a drum kit respectively, neither of whom are moving. The background features a piano, wooden storage shelves, and acoustic foam panels on the walls under bright, warm indoor lighting.
